purpose: head-end thermal BC for the pintle-servo mount check (lead request 2026-10-12)

n2o_side.geometry: representative annulus 8 mm bore / 4 mm stem (D_h 4 mm, A 37.7 mm2) ASSUMED
n2o_side.formula: h_c = 0.023 Re^0.8 Pr^0.4 k / D_h, Re = (mdot/A) D_h / mu
n2o_side.coast: static liquid at the tank temperature, hA 1 W/K (ASSUMED 1000 W/m2K x 10 cm2)
n2o_side.soak: vapour only, hA 0.01 W/K (no evaporative credit)

pintle_needle.note: 17-4PH 4 mm stem over 0.10 m: 2.3e-3 W/K, i.e. < 1 W at 300 K difference: the needle is not a heat path to the servo; its tip takes the injector-face BC

not_modelled: axial conduction along the 6061 case from the hot aft end (post-landing item for the FEA: fin m 4.5 1/m, cosh mL 1.8, diffusion ~1000 s); head-to-servo path (bonnet, bracket)
